set.pl: Lots 7-8, block 17, Torrent and Arms Plat, east side of Center St, North Muskegon
pinev: House lot from the 1900 Standard Atlas North Muskegon plat, located by street centroids on an unreferenced plat (about 100 m).
set.tovw: Lead grade B: two local accounts and a placed lot (treasure thread)
set.st: Aged Civil War veteran Harvey Chilson, a miser who traded paper money for gold pieces at local stores, died alone in June 1897; about $3,000 in gold was never found and his estate came to $119.83. Neighbours thought it was hid in or near his house. The house stood on lots 7-8, block 17 (Torrent and Arms Plat), east side of Center St; in June 1897 a county road was cut across the lot and the house was moved to one corner. Urban residential lot: look-only without the owner's permission.

src: Standard Atlas of Muskegon County (1900), North Muskegon plat
